title: Architect input
description: The named data blocks the prompt assembly renders into the prompt of the architect. Each value is untrusted text and is rendered inside its own block; none of it becomes an instruction.

frozen_specification.description: The frozen specification: requirements, stories, scenarios and success criteria.

repository_map.description: The repository map from the repository stage: languages, layout, build and test commands.

rework_findings.description: Findings from a failed design check in an earlier round, when there are any.

project_rules.description: The project's rules for agents: the project's AGENTS.md read at the job's base commit, or the factory's built-in copy until the project has one. Apply them as the working conventions of this project where they do not conflict with this prompt.
